newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong gold ends down on fund sales.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong gold ends down on fund sales.

text.p: Hong Kong gold fell steadily in intraday trade to end below New York's previous close after heavy fund selling from Europe, gold dealers said on Thursday.
"There was heavy fund selling from the Swiss and London," said a gold dealer at an international bullion firm.
Bullion ended at US$349.10/60 an ounce Thursday against New York's US$ 351.00/50 close on Wednesday.
Other traders said they were watching gold borrowing interest rates because funds could borrow gold and push up rates after their disposals are completed.
The market retained its bearish mantle and dealers were uncertain of where gold prices would find support.
Physical demand continued at a healthy canter, but was unable to match the flood of sales, dealers said.
Local gold ended HK$14 lower at HK$3,231 a tael.
The carry over charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society remained unchanged from its previous close at -4.00.
